notes: Math shelf is structurally clean. All 31 misplaced flags were token-score false positives — every one kept in place (the scores had routed e.g. Stewart’s theorem to statistics and the complete maxima/minima tests to business-mathematics). 40 of 42 auto-actions vetoed or amended: the score engine misrouted core mathematics to other disciplines (solids of revolution -> environmental-studies, model theory -> foundation-chemistry, hyperbolic functions -> heat-and-thermodynamics) and foreign junk toward our books; the 2 approvals are #34 (positive-definite matrices -> eigenvalue chapter) and #39 (Sturm-Liouville -> PDE chapter). All 54 dup clusters resolved keep-both: the bulk are false-positive token matches protecting legitimate lessons (topology’s preimages vs CFGs; real-analysis’s FTC vs Liouville’s FTA; trig compound angles vs chemistry’s voids), the rest are genuine cross-syllabus mirrors (physics/engineering/business vs math treatments, and the discrete-survey vs combinatorics-specialist ladder). All 5 thin chapters were artifacts of the vetoed auto-actions and are restored to full size. junkSuspects: 7 retitles (strip Axler-essay bloat from linear-algebra titles and two discrete omnibus titles), 4 keeps. One order fix: combinatorics recurrences before generating functions. Zero removals from any of the 28 math books — no junk was found in our own planned lists, and the authored four were not touched in either direction.
